newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian August import prices rose 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian August import prices rose 0.5 pct.

text.p: Australian import prices rose 0.5 percent in August from the previous month and were 7.1 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
A decrease in the value of the Australian dollar against the major trading currencies led to price increases in a wide range of items in August," the bureau said in a statement.
"This is the first (monthly) increase recorded in the index since December, 1995."
Major movements in the import price index were in road vehicles, specialised machinery and petroleum and related products, the bureau said.
"Partly offsetting the price rises were decreases for a number of items, the most significant of which were paper and related products and chemical materials and products."
